about.title: Angel Barrientos — Technical Lead & Software Architect
about.summary: Software engineer with 16 years of experience. Backend-first, with architectural and operational criteria.
about.profile:
Senior backend developer with sixteen years of professional experience. I work primarily in PHP — from 5.6 through 8.x — and Python 3.x, as well as JavaScript with Node.js; in recent years I have added C# on .NET 6. I retain working experience in Java 1.6, which explains my bias toward object-oriented design.
I have used Linux as my primary OS since 2008 — back in the kernel 2.6 era — with Bash/Shell scripting, service administration, and a natural progression toward cloud and containerized environments.

I think of software as a living structure: modular, scalable, and readable. Hexagonal architecture is, put simply, the architecture of the house. I follow ecosystem conventions (PSR in PHP, PEP in Python), enjoy unit testing, and document in Markdown. Simple tastes, precise tools.
about.value_detail: Order under pressure, sustainable technical decisions, documentation that explains the why — not only the what.
about.role_now: Standards, reviews, team support, business and client coordination. I keep AWS healthy and close gaps in legacy code.
about.softskills: Negotiation, assertive communication, active listening, bias handling, delegation and hiring. They make the technical part land intact.
